_comment: THE BARLOQUE SELL CIRCUIT — a multi-stop alternative to selling everything to Roq (room 110).
This is the SHAPE (committed). The live copy is substrate/sellrun.json, which is gitignored
because it is an ORDER to this machine's fleet, not a description of the game.
WHY IT EXISTS. townDestinations() picks ONE shop, and for a mixed pack that shop is Roq — the
one NPC that buys every category. The Barloque specialists each buy only their own lane, so no
single one clears a pack. This spec routes the pack ACROSS them: equipment to the smith, gems to
the jeweler, reagents to the herbalist, the rare keepers into the vault, then reagents bought and
the surplus banked. Roq is never visited, which is the point while room 110's tunnel is unsafe.
SELLING IS AN ALLOWLIST AND MERCHANTS ARE PICKY (docs/m59-economy.md): a smith handed a mushroom
answers with silence, and a banker-robber (Skivlat) takes it and gives nothing. So each stop names
the exact merchant and the exact item CLASSES it accepts, derived from what it SELLS in
substrate/m59-merchants.json — a merchant buys the lane it sells. m59-sellrun.mjs verifies every
sale by the purse delta and never trusts the handshake.

stops.note: Barloque armourer/smith: body armour, shields, weapons. NOT on the trusted allowlist yet — dry-run and verify a purse delta before trusting live.
Sparkling Stone Shop. Verified buyer (paid 856). SELL_TO /herbutte/i.
Herbs and Roots. Verified buyer. Sells reagents too — could double as the reagent BUY stop if you skip Tos.

vault.note: Deposit — never sell — anything worth keeping for later: the vigor mushrooms, the rare drops, unidentified wands/scrolls. Storage survives death, which selling does not.

buy_reagents.note: User's route buys 100 each at Tos. Barloque's own Joguer (104) sells them too, on-route — set at_room:104 to skip the Tos leg. create food costs 2 herb + 2 elderberry per cast.

bank.note: Deposit the sale proceeds above walking money. Bank 1 is Tos AND Jasper (blakston.khd:1275). Everything carried is lost on death; a balance is not.

keep_always.note: Never sold or vaulted regardless of lane: money, the wielded weapon, worn armour, and whatever this character's loadout marks keep. m59-sellrun reads the loadout and the worn/wielded lists.
